emblems.name: Neckless Knuckle
emblems.flavor: The big fist-bone off its shoulder, still grass-stained from where it stood its ground and then didn't.

emblems.name: Twitching Hock
emblems.flavor: A back leg that kept kicking dirt for a minute after the rest of it stopped caring.

emblems.name: The One Good Eye
emblems.flavor: Thumbed out at arm's length, which is closer than it ever wanted anything to be.

emblems.name: Drip Fang
emblems.flavor: Snapped off at the gum and still beading, so hold it by the fat end.

emblems.name: Both-Sides Jawplate
emblems.flavor: Same slab of bone left and right, which is exactly why it took so long to find the seam.

emblems.name: Bog-Packed Fist
emblems.flavor: Knuckle bone with marsh mud rammed into every crack, because it went down face first.

emblems.name: Split Paddle Foot
emblems.flavor: Webbed and torn, from something that ran across water right up until the water ran out.

emblems.name: Reed-Cut Eyelid
emblems.flavor: Peeled off the socket in one piece, sliced up from a lifetime of squinting through sharp grass.

emblems.name: Leech-Beaded Gland
emblems.flavor: The venom sac out of its neck, three fat leeches still hanging off it and unbothered.

emblems.name: Slimed Shoulder Plate
emblems.flavor: Armour off its back, so evenly built you can't tell which half you tore first.

emblems.name: Chipped Knuckle Stone
emblems.flavor: Bone worn flat as scree from punching rock, and it never learned the rock was winning.

emblems.name: Scrabble Claw
emblems.flavor: Four toes' worth of hooks, all filed down to nubs by a lot of very fast bad decisions.

emblems.name: Ledge-Watcher's Brow
emblems.flavor: The bony shelf it sighted from, cracked off with the dust of its last perch still on it.

emblems.name: Crevice Tongue
emblems.flavor: Long, grey and forked, pulled out of a throat that got used to swallowing in the dark.

emblems.name: Twin-Horn Boss
emblems.flavor: Both horns and the skull between them, matched so well you'd swear it was made to annoy you.

emblems.name: Barnacled Knucklebone
emblems.flavor: Crusted white with shells, off an arm that spent years hitting surf and losing.

emblems.name: Sand-Scoured Heel
emblems.flavor: Rubbed raw and smooth by wet sand, torn free while the rest of it was still sprinting.

emblems.name: Salt-Blind Lens
emblems.flavor: The good eye gone milky at the edges, because staring down a bright shore costs you something.

emblems.name: Tidepool Fang
emblems.flavor: Hollow, curved, and stinking of low tide; the bite mark it left is still in your shoulder.

emblems.name: Even-Keeled Rib
emblems.flavor: One rib off a cage where every rib was the same, pried out with your knee on its chest.

emblems.name: Ash-Baked Fist
emblems.flavor: Knuckle bone cooked grey through, from a thing that kept swinging in air too hot to breathe.

emblems.name: Cinder-Burnt Tendon
emblems.flavor: Pulled hot out of the back leg, still smelling like the crust it ran across barefoot.

emblems.name: Smoke-Cooked Eye
emblems.flavor: Popped, cured and shrunk hard by the vents; it never once saw you get close.

emblems.name: Black Throat Sac
emblems.flavor: Cut out whole and still warm, from the last mouth on this rock that bit before it looked.

emblems.name: Unbroken Grey Skullcap
emblems.flavor: The top of its head, thick and dull and identical all the way round, and you finally stopped looking for the soft bit.
